name: policymate
description: 松警伴侣（PoliceMate）移动端 H5 受控试行版

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @policymate/server" "npm run dev -w @policymate/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @policymate/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @policymate/server && npm run typecheck -w @policymate/web && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
